metadata.boundary: Working Pride in Place boundary (from 9 Oct 2026) = published MSOA E02005617 'North Northamptonshire 007' (Kingswood and Hazel Leys) + the Exeter estate LSOAs E01026951 (005C) and E01026950 (005B, incl. Burghley Drive NN18 8DX). The two Exeter LSOAs sit in MSOA E02005616, outside the published MSOA.
metadata.exeter_data: Exeter LSOAs are not in the Aug data pack: IMD 2025 for 005C from the pack, for 005B from the MHCLG Local Deprivation Explorer; Census 2021 for both from Nomis using the pack's method.
metadata.claimant: Claimant rate = ONS published claimants as a proportion of residents aged 16-64, July 2026 (Nomis NM_162_1), for all nine LSOAs. Whole-area rate is approximate.
metadata.data: Pride in Place Corby - Deprivation Data Pack.xlsx (compiled Aug 2026): IMD 2025 ranks of 33,755 (1 = most deprived); Census 2021 by LSOA; claimant count Jul 2026.
metadata.town: Corby Town Council area: the 37 LSOAs inside Corby civil parish (ONS OA21 to parish lookup). Wards are the four parish wards set by SI 2024/157, drawn as the May 2025 NNC wards clipped to the parish (ONS WD_MAY_2025_UK_BGC_V2, PARNCP_DEC_2025_EW_BGC).
metadata.epc: EPC register (MHCLG 'Get energy performance of buildings data'), domestic full-load CSV regenerated 2026-10-13. Latest certificate per property (by UPRN, or by address where there is no UPRN), then each property placed in an LSOA through its postcode (postcodes.io, 2021 LSOAs). Rates are of homes with a certificate, not of all homes. North Northants and England use the same method on every certificate in the file (England = local authority codes starting E).
